targets.query: from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system.cpu.utilization") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^total$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system.memory.usage") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^used$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system.network.io") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^rx_bytes|tx_bytes$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
